info.name: Indexing + Project Knowledge (Stage 1)
info.description:
Postman collection for haystack-fast-api multi-call journey:

1) **Call 1** `POST /internal/v1/recommendations/submitprojectspecification` — indexing + mandatory KG-1 + lean FR-IX-023 body
2) **Call 2** `POST /internal/v1/recommendations/project-knowledge/getassetrecommendations` — **recommend / quote** (`quoteRef`, `items[]`, rates)
3) **Call 3** `POST /internal/v1/recommendations/project-knowledge/query` — **chatbot Q&A** (`answer`, hits, tool_traces)

**Import:** Collection + environment `Indexing-Pipeline-Local`.
**Server:** `uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload` from `haystack-fast-api/`.
**Files:** For multipart requests, attach fixtures from `postman/fixtures/`.

**Portal saga:** Run Call 1 (ingest) then Call 2 (recommend) so `ingestId` is saved; React primary body is Call 2 quote.
Call 3 chatbot is optional follow-up (same `userId` + `ingestId`).
Sessions are process-local; use the same server for all calls.
Default `PROJECT_AGENT_MODE=stub` (no LLM key required for Call 3).

**Call 1 success:** `ingest_id`, `user_id`, `user_requirement_summary`, dates, needs, budget, warnings.
**Call 2 success:** `quoteRef`, `items[].equipment`, rates, `specSummary`, `rationale` (not Q&A `answer`).
**Call 3 success:** `answer`, `sources_used`, `tool_traces`, `research_hits`, `graph_hits`.
